findings.evidence: notification_settings Update type declares "user_id": string as required, while every other table's Update type makes all columns optional.
findings.impact: Type-only inconsistency: a future partial .update() on notification_settings would be forced to pass user_id. No runtime effect; the current UI uses upsert (Insert type), so nothing breaks today.
findings.recommendation: Make user_id optional in the Update type the next time database.types.ts is regenerated or touched. Non-blocking for merge.
